stem: A work order identifies Zone B, but the controller screen is currently set to Zone C. What should the technician do?
choices: Run Zone C because it is already selected
Resolve the zone/work-order mismatch before starting the event
Run both zones to be safe
Guess which zone needs water from plant height
rationale: Crop and zone identity must be correct before execution. Guessing can create both missed irrigation and unintended irrigation.
